text: The town gathers

Luna claimed to be the officer on day two and said Haiku had checked clean, and the real officer, Sonnet, never challenged that claim. Day one had already gone badly, with the town voting out Gemma the mayor after Haiku and Sol turned on the wrong people. The turning point came on night two, when the killers took Sonnet, leaving Luna's claim unchallenged. Day two ended with Terra, one of the killers, voted out in a runoff, but Sol had trusted Luna's claim too quickly and was taken on night three. Luna and Terra's killer team won the game.
